linux_baseline_20261024.scope: Development reconciliation for selected dense Linux baseline only: manifest versions 1-3 and local DIT 7; rejects 4/5/6, does not integrate Bonsai/Hadamard. Includes Llama GGUF rotary-row and Q8-head packing fixes. Not a series with the other patches; DIT and long-context quality acceptance remain open.

linux_runtime_pr209_20261024.scope: Standalone development reconciliation against base478, incorporating linux-baseline and PR209 runtime features; updated2026-10-25. Manifest1-7 with local DIT7 and preserved Llama hi/lo sub-block attention. GGUF Q/K/Q8-head corrections, checked dense head dimensions, flash streams through8192, explicit paired probabilities and unsupported-window refusal. Paired-P300/8192 and real4096-boundary model gates pass; artificial zero-history cosine failure remains. Includes synthetic --bench-kernel seek fix, compact5120 packing regression, and explicit experimental bfp16_hilo block input (9/4 bytes; native F32 output), independent host-pack tests and fail-closed incompatible-scope metadata. Compensated route300/8192/real-boundary gates pass; accepted end-to-end speed remains unmeasured under idle conditions. Bonsai/Hadamard and broad DIT/family acceptance remain open. Not a sequential patch series or default promotion.

gemma4_block_prefill_20261029.note: dense gemm_block cd_preffn / cd_postffn: the block route's FFN-side sandwich norms from the consts (Gemma 4's folded layer_output_scale) instead of the file

gemma4_bringup_dumps_20261029.note: bring-up only: open_qwen36_cli --dump-act all:<prefix> (every layer's whole act) and --dump-kv <prefix> (checkpoint KV rows)

gemma4_compact_gguf_20261029.note: std_perm_gguf packs into the pool's chunk law: 6144-B f32 scales, or 5120-B q4_1-law bf16 scales (RNE, what the f32-scale kernels narrow to on the core) for the compact GGUF view; the branch of linux_runtime_pr209_20261024 without its Llama rotary permute

gemma4_attn_block_20261029.note: dense attn_block prep qkvnorm_rope (Gemma 4): q / k norms from the consts, weightless V norm, score scale, per-layer-type rotation (pair distance) and inv_freq, sliding window (first row, softmax mask, windowed read-back), Q hi / lo; attn_window_test. A diff over base plus the three earlier Gemma 4 patches, unlike the standalone ones

gemma4_prefill_host_20261029.note: the dense block route's host stages, bit-identical: the sandwich joins in one pass a token row (sandwich_rows), the FFN activation's fp64 half under the up projection's dispatch and h = act * up straight into the down projection's tiled x (act_fp64, act_tile), attention_npu's row loops and the K / V tilers over the host threads, and a layer-major prompt for the dense kind (step_gemm_prompt_dense: every block's qkv3, then their attention, then the rest; on for qkvnorm_rope sets, OFLM_OPEN_DENSE_LAYER_MAJOR). A diff over base plus the four earlier Gemma 4 patches

gemma4_bfp16_prefill_20261030.note: the dense block route's GEMMs on gemm_bfp16 (OPEN-PREFILL-BFP16 on the dense kind): manifest_version 4 (the bfp16_gemm pack op, row0 / n_total, and the bfp16 step format with n_pad; a bfp16 step reads exactly a bfp16_gemm weight, dense routes only), bfp16_gemm from a GGUF tensor's own blocks (embed_row) as well as q4nx q4_1 chunks, the activation packer and the c-tiled output read back as [N, T] or token rows, act * up encoded straight into the down projection's A operand (act_bfp16_a), and the prefill route chosen in the GGUF view too, where a GGUF-direct set carries its routes (fast = gemm_block, lean = the variant). bfp16.hpp is the granite branch's (openflowlm-next 07e635b) plus bfp16_c_offset. A diff over base plus the five earlier Gemma 4 patches

gemma4_prefill_pipeline_20261030.note: the dense layer-major prompt step-major (dense_layer_staged, on unless OFLM_OPEN_STAGE_MAJOR=0): qkv3 over every block with each block's attention host half under the next block's GEMM, the attention products over every (block, kv head), then o / up / gate / down over the blocks in pairs, one run outstanding and #1 twins of every x / y / attn_block global (pipeline()); each block's operations unchanged, so the same bits. The bfp16 route's GELU-tanh act in fp32 on AVX2 fused with act * up and the encode (gelu_bfp16_a, OFLM_OPEN_GELU32=0 keeps act_fp64). The A-operand encoders write in memory order and bfp16_encode_block takes its exponent maximum on the vector unit. attn_block's optional kernels_shl: qsplit's hi / lo scores as one product of 2 m rows (OFLM_OPEN_ATTN_SHL=0 off). The bfp16_gemm packer without per-block divisions, and a pack weight zeroes only the bytes no op writes (pools::unwritten). --prefill-mode accurate is lean. A diff over base plus the six earlier Gemma 4 patches
